headline_marked: Police suspect [[woman raped and strangled to death]] in Savar flat
headline: Police suspect woman raped and strangled to death in Savar flat
summary: A 35-year-old woman was found dead in her rented home near Hajinagar of Boro Deshi after her daughter returned from a friend's house.
details: A 35-year-old woman was found dead inside her third-floor flat near Hajinagar of Boro Deshi in Savar on Thursday night.
The victim, identified as Sharmin Akter Liza, worked in the marketing department of a cosmetics company in the capital.
The discovery was made by her daughter, Samiya Akter Jerin, who found her mother's body on the bed after returning from a friend's house in the evening.
Neighbors were alerted and contacted the national emergency service 999 to report the incident.
According to Sub-Inspector Zakir Al Hossain of the Amin Bazar police outpost, initial findings suggest the woman was raped and then strangled to death.
The body has been sent to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for a postmortem examination.
Police are currently conducting drives to identify and arrest those involved in the crime.
caption:
A 35-year-old woman was found dead in her Savar flat; police suspect she was raped and strangled.

A 35-year-old woman was found dead inside her third-floor flat near Hajinagar of Boro Deshi in Savar on Thursday night.

The victim, identified as Sharmin Akter Liza, worked in the marketing department of a cosmetics company in the capital.

The discovery was made by her daughter, Samiya Akter Jerin, who found her mother's body on the bed after returning from a friend's house in the evening.

Neighbors were alerted and contacted the national emergency service 999 to report the incident.

According to Sub-Inspector Zakir Al Hossain of the Amin Bazar police outpost, initial findings suggest the woman was raped and then strangled to death.

The body has been sent to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital for a postmortem examination.

Police are currently conducting drives to identify and arrest those involved in the crime.
